args.name: Loan Rules
args.content: Books are lent for 21 days, DVDs for 7 days, reference books never leave the library. Late fees are charged per overdue day (books $0.25, DVDs $1.00) and capped at $15 per loan. Members with $10 or more in open fees cannot borrow.

args.name: Reservation Queue
args.content: Reservations are served first-come-first-served per item. When a copy is returned, the next waiting reservation becomes 'ready' and is held for 3 days. Expired holds move to the next member in the queue.

args.name: Layering
args.content: Entscheidung: api -> services -> repositories -> domain. Begruendung: controllers stay thin and map DomainError subclasses to HTTP status codes; services own all business rules; repositories are in-memory and replaceable.

args.title: Allow renewing loans twice at most
args.description: Members can currently renew a loan indefinitely as long as nobody reserved the item. Limit renewals to two per loan and return a clear 409 error from the API when the limit is reached.
args.workInstructions: Add a renewCount field to Loan, increment it in CirculationService.renew, throw RuleViolation after two renewals. Acceptance: third renew call fails with 409.

args.title: Send SMS reminders for family members
args.description: Family tier members asked for SMS reminders instead of email. ReminderScheduler should pick the SmsNotifier for members with tier 'family' and keep email for everybody else.
args.workInstructions: Inject both notifiers into ReminderScheduler, choose by member.tier in sendDueSoonReminders and sendOverdueNotices. Acceptance: family members receive SMS only.

args.title: Fix double hold when two copies return at once
args.description: When two copies of the same item are returned in quick succession, promoteNext can mark the same reservation ready twice and notify the member twice. Make promotion idempotent per reservation.
args.workInstructions: In ReservationService.promoteNext skip reservations that are already ready; add a regression test in tests/reservations.test.ts. Acceptance: exactly one notification.

args.title: Search: filter catalogue by media type
args.description: The search endpoint returns books and DVDs mixed together. Add an optional type filter (book, dvd) to SearchService.search and the GET /search route so the frontend can show separate tabs.
args.workInstructions: Extend SearchService.search with an optional type parameter, pass params.type through router and LibraryController.handleSearch. Acceptance: /search?q=m&type=dvd returns only DVDs.

args.title: Student tier: waive fees during exam weeks
args.description: The student council asked whether late fees could be waived during exam weeks. Needs a configurable calendar of exam weeks and a check in FeeCalculator before charging student members.
args.workInstructions: Clarify the exam calendar source with the library staff first, then add an optional waiver predicate to FeeCalculator. Acceptance: no fee for students inside exam weeks.

args.title: Persist repositories in SQLite
args.description: All repositories are in-memory, so every restart loses the catalogue and loans. Introduce a SQLite-backed implementation behind the same InMemoryRepository interface without changing the services.
args.workInstructions: Create SqliteRepository implementing findById/all/save/remove, wire it in createLibrary behind a flag. Acceptance: existing tests pass against both implementations.
